text: Yet why should this needs follow? since poverty is dishonorable not in itself, but when it is a proof of laziness, intemperance, luxury, and carelessness; whereas in a person that is temperate, industrious, just, and valiant, and who uses all his virtues for the public good, it shows a great and lofty mind.
author: Plutarch
locator: Comparison of Aristides with Marcus Cato
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
